description: Two independent delay lines in 3HP, each mixing its delayed signal back with its input and each with its own feedback path

params.text: An attenuverter, setting the level and the polarity of the signal at the IN 2 jack of that delay line
Sets the delay time of that delay line
Sets how much of the delayed signal is fed back into that delay line
Balances the input against the delayed signal at that section's output

inputs.text: A signal into that delay line at full level
A second signal into that delay line, scaled by the attenuverter above it; feeding an output back in here builds a feedback loop
A voltage added to the delay time set by DELAY
A voltage added to the feedback amount set by FB

outputs.text: The mix of the input and the delayed signal for that delay line

notes: the first delay line runs to 200ms and the second to 2000ms, and their delay CV inputs add 20ms and 200ms per volt.
feedback reaches 1.05, above unity, so a delay line can build up without limit.
